# Speck Family Dealerships

> Speck Family Dealerships is a family-owned group of new and used car, truck, and SUV dealerships serving Washington State's Yakima Valley and Tri-Cities region, with 7 locations across Prosser, Sunnyside, Pasco, and Kennewick, representing Chevrolet, Ford, GMC, Buick, Hyundai, Nissan, Chrysler, Jeep, Dodge, and Ram.

Speck Family Dealerships has been serving Washington State drivers with new vehicle sales, used and certified pre-owned vehicles, financing, vehicle service and maintenance, and OEM parts. Each dealership location specializes in one or more vehicle brands and operates its own local inventory and service department, while sharing a common commitment to customer service across the Speck family of stores.

## Locations

- [Speck Chevrolet of Prosser](https://www.speckchevyprosser.com/): 314 Sixth St, Prosser, WA 99350. Phone: (509) 786-2666. New and used Chevrolet vehicles.
- [Speck Nissan of Sunnyside](https://www.specknissan.com/): 61 E Allen Rd, Sunnyside, WA 98944. Phone: (509) 837-5501. New and used Nissan vehicles.
- [Speck Hyundai of Tri-Cities](https://www.speckhyundai.com/): 2910 W Clearwater Ave, Kennewick, WA 99336. Phone: (509) 542-0234. New and used Hyundai vehicles.
- [Speck Buick GMC of Tri-Cities](https://www.speckbuickgmc.com/): 9610 Sandifur Pkwy, Pasco, WA 99301. Phone: (509) 783-9399. New and used Buick and GMC vehicles.
- [Speck Chrysler Jeep Dodge Ram](https://www.speckcdjr.com/): 125 E Allen Rd, Sunnyside, WA 98944. Phone: (509) 882-5005. New and used Chrysler, Jeep, Dodge, and Ram vehicles.
- [Speck Ford of Prosser](https://www.speckford.com/): 630 Wine Country Rd, Prosser, WA 99350. Phone: (509) 786-2155. New and used Ford vehicles.
- [C. Speck Motors](https://www.cspeckmotors.com/): 61 E Allen Rd, Sunnyside, WA 98944. Phone: (509) 837-5501. Independent used vehicle dealership.

## Services

- New Vehicles: Search new inventory across all Speck locations and brands.
- Used Vehicles: Used, certified pre-owned, and one-owner CarFax vehicles across all locations.
- Work Trucks: Commercial and fleet work truck inventory, new and used.
- Specials: Current new and used vehicle offers, truck and SUV specials.
- Finance: Get pre-qualified, value a trade-in, and explore credit and loan resources.
- [Service](https://www.speckdealerships.com/service): Schedule vehicle service and maintenance at any Speck location.
- Parts: Order OEM parts for any Speck-represented brand.

## About

- Speck Family Dealerships is a family-owned automotive group headquartered in Sunnyside, Washington, operating dealerships throughout the Yakima Valley and Tri-Cities area of Washington State.
- [Homepage](https://speckdealerships.com/): Main website linking to all dealership locations, inventory search, specials, financing, and service scheduling.
